cues.zh: 我们在 JSConf

cues.zh: US

cues.zh: 五月份宣布了开源

cues.zh: 基本上，我们对某些传统的

cues.zh: 在我们讨论它的时候，希望你能给它五分钟的时间。我们已经在大型团队的大型应用中大量使用了它，

cues.zh: 但我们非常重视让它能和你的技术栈友好协作，不管你的技术栈是什么。所以，早期很多 React 的成功案例，都是在已有项目中先接入一小部分，然后随着时间推移，逐渐将它用于越来越多的应用功能。

cues.en: So, we're going to talk about a couple of things today.
cues.zh: 今天我们会聊几个方面。

cues.zh: 首先，我会讲一些前置知识。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: we like to combine the DOM generation and display logic rather than using a templating system. And a lot of people don't agree with that and I wanted to explain why we think that that's a great idea.
cues.zh: 我们倾向于把 DOM 生成和显示逻辑结合起来，而不是使用模板系统。很多人并不认同这一点，所以我想解释一下为什么我们认为这是个很好的想法。

cues.en: Then I'm gonna go into React's design. So what makes building applications
cues.zh: 然后我会讲 React 的设计。那么，用 React 构建应用

cues.en: with React really, really fun and easy?
cues.zh: 为什么会如此有趣、如此简单？

cues.en: And the the core idea there is we basically rerender the app every time the data changes.
cues.zh: 这里的核心思想是：每次数据发生变化时，我们都会重新渲染整个应用。

cues.zh: 最后，很多人真正感兴趣的是我们的独特实现。

cues.en: So, we've built this JavaScript library from the ground up using a lot of different ideas than other libraries. So, I'd like to talk about that too.
cues.zh: 我们从头开始构建了这个 JavaScript 库，采用了许多不同于其他库的理念。所以这一点我也想聊聊。

cues.en: So, let's dive into the first thing, which is building components and not templates.
cues.zh: 那么，我们先来看看第一件事：构建组件，而不是模板。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: I'm sure everyone here has built a UI with JavaScript before. Right? Everyone?
cues.zh: 我相信在座各位之前都用 JavaScript 构建过 UI，对吧？大家都用过吧？

cues.en: Has anybody used a client side templating library like handlebars is a really high quality one?
cues.zh: 有人用过客户端模板库吗？比如 Handlebars，它就是一个质量很高的库。

cues.en: A lot of people use them on the server as well.
cues.zh: 很多人也会在服务器端使用它们。

cues.en: So cynically,
cues.zh: 所以，比较直白地说，

cues.en: like to think of of components as mixing markup and display logic.
cues.zh: 我们倾向于把组件看作标记和显示逻辑的结合。

cues.en: But we do like separation of concerns. Right? That's the kind of the number one reason for using a template. So,
cues.zh: 但我们确实喜欢关注点分离。对吧？这大概是使用模板的首要原因。所以，

cues.en: a templating language basically takes in a data structure
cues.zh: 模板语言基本上会接收一个数据结构

cues.en: and combines it with an HTML document marked up with some special directives and spits out some static markup.
cues.zh: 把它和一个用特殊指令标记过的 HTML 文档结合起来，然后输出一些静态标记。

cues.en: But separation of concerns,
cues.zh: 但关注点分离，

cues.en: really isn't a specific
cues.zh: 其实并不是一个具体的

cues.en: term. Right? Like,
cues.zh: 术语。对吧？就像，

cues.en: what are concerns? They're... It's very ill defined. So, I'd like to kind of zoom in on this definition
cues.zh: 什么是关注点？它们是……这个定义非常模糊。所以，我想稍微深入一下这个定义

cues.en: and talk about coupling and cohesion.
cues.zh: 谈谈耦合和内聚。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: these are terms from software engineering
cues.zh: 这些是软件工程里的术语

cues.en: and we're talking about reducing coupling and increasing cohesion.
cues.zh: 我们说的是降低耦合、提高内聚。

cues.en: So coupling is the degree to which each module in a program relies on the other modules in a program.
cues.zh: 耦合是指程序中每个模块依赖其他模块的程度。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: think about the really annoying bugs or features that you had to build in your day to day like work.
cues.zh: 想想你日常工作中不得不构建的那些特别烦人的 bug 或功能。

cues.en: Usually, ones that are constrained
cues.zh: 通常，那些被限制在

cues.en: to a single function are pretty easy to deal with. Right? You go in, you isolate where the problem is, you fix that function or that class and you move on with your life.
cues.zh: 单个函数里的问题都挺容易处理。对吧？你进去，定位问题所在，修好那个函数或那个类，然后继续你的生活。

cues.en: Maybe add a unit test too to make sure that it doesn't happen again.
cues.zh: 也许再加个单元测试，确保它不会再发生。

cues.en: The really painful bugs and features are the ones that
cues.zh: 真正痛苦的那些 bug 和功能，是那种

cues.en: you have to make changes to multiple modules.
cues.zh: 你必须改动多个模块的。

cues.en: So, we like to call these cascading changes and they're a symptom of
cues.zh: 我们喜欢把这些叫作级联变更，它们是

cues.en: tight coupling.
cues.zh: 紧耦合的症状。

cues.en: So, kind of the way I think of coupling is that if I want to make a change to some piece of functionality,
cues.zh: 所以，我对耦合的理解大概是：如果我想改动某块功能，

cues.en: do I have to make a change to this module and does it affect all the other modules requiring me to make changes to them?
cues.zh: 我是否必须改这个模块，而且它会不会影响所有其他模块，导致我也得改它们？

cues.en: And that's what makes software really hard to maintain.
cues.zh: 这就是让软件很难维护的原因。

cues.en: Another term that we like to think about is cohesion.
cues.zh: 我们还会考虑的另一个术语是内聚。

cues.en: So, cohesion is the degree to which elements of a module belong together. So, you can have the most decoupled architecture
cues.zh: 内聚是指一个模块内各元素彼此归属的程度。所以，你可以拥有最解耦的架构

cues.en: ever,
cues.zh: 有史以来，

cues.en: but if those modules
cues.zh: 但如果那些模块

cues.en: don't really make sense in terms of the functionality that they contain,
cues.zh: 从它们包含的功能来看并不合理，

cues.en: it's also not going to be maintainable because it's going be hard for you to figure out,
cues.zh: 它同样无法维护，因为你会很难搞清楚，

cues.en: you know, where to make the change because those concerns are kind of spread all over your program.
cues.zh: 你知道，该在哪里做改动，因为这些关注点有点散布在整个程序里。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: I think that templates encourage a really poor separation of concerns.
cues.zh: 我认为模板会助长非常糟糕的关注点分离。

cues.en: And it's not just templates. It's anything that really tries to mark up an HTML document
cues.zh: 而且不只是模板。任何真正试图标记 HTML 文档

cues.en: and you know, make it alive and and really make it interactive.
cues.zh: 并且你知道，让它活起来、真正具有交互性的东西都是。

cues.en: So, angular JS style directives also fall into this category.
cues.zh: 所以，AngularJS 风格的指令也属于这一类。

cues.en: And why would I say that? Because obviously, when you create a template and you have your display logic in one file and your markup in another file, that seems like a reasonable separation of concerns. Right? When I want to change the way that the application behaves, I go to the JavaScript file with the display logic. And when I want to change the way that it looks, I go into the template and change the template. Right?
cues.zh: 那我为什么这么说？因为显然，当你创建一个模板，把显示逻辑放在一个文件里，把标记放在另一个文件里，这看起来像是合理的关注点分离。对吧？当我想改变应用的行为方式时，我会去找带显示逻辑的 JavaScript 文件。当我想改变它的外观时，我会进到模板里改模板。对吧？

cues.en: It's actually kind of a misunderstanding
cues.zh: 这其实有点误会

cues.en: because there is an implicit coupling between that display logic and the template.
cues.zh: 因为显示逻辑和模板之间存在隐式耦合。

cues.en: So, the template's always gonna need to read some data from JavaScript. Right? JavaScript
cues.zh: 所以模板总得从 JavaScript 读取一些数据，对吧？JavaScript

cues.en: fetches from the server,
cues.zh: 从服务器获取数据，

cues.en: tells the template what to do and then the template renders it.
cues.zh: 告诉模板该做什么，然后模板把它渲染出来。

cues.en: However, imagine that I wanted to implement a zebra striped table.
cues.zh: 不过，假设我想实现一个斑马纹表格。

cues.en: So, it's a data table with alternating row colors.
cues.zh: 也就是行颜色交替的数据表。

cues.en: With a template,
cues.zh: 用模板的话，

cues.en: a lot of times you have to pass along that row color in your view model, which is the piece of data that your your controller or your display logic passes to your template.
cues.zh: 很多时候，你必须在视图模型里传入行颜色，也就是控制器或显示逻辑传给模板的那份数据。

cues.en: Now, if you want to change the way that the template renders,
cues.zh: 现在，如果你想改变模板的渲染方式，

cues.en: you can't actually only change the template anymore because you have to make sure that the data in your view model is synced between the template and the display logic.
cues.zh: 其实就不能只改模板了，因为你必须确保视图模型里的数据在模板和显示逻辑之间保持同步。

cues.en: So, we actually like to think of display logic and markup as inevitably tightly coupled because
cues.zh: 所以我们倾向于认为显示逻辑和标记不可避免地紧密耦合，因为

cues.en: you basically need to update the DOM somehow.
cues.zh: 你基本上总得用某种方式更新 DOM。

cues.en: And you need to to somehow couple the state of the DOM with your display logic.
cues.zh: 而且你得设法把 DOM 的状态和显示逻辑耦合起来。

cues.en: But the good news is is that they're actually highly cohesive because they're doing the same thing. Right? So, think about what your template does.
cues.zh: 但好消息是，它们其实内聚性很高，因为它们在干同一件事，对吧？想想模板做了什么。

cues.en: Your template generates HTML.
cues.zh: 模板生成 HTML。

cues.en: The browser parses the HTML
cues.zh: 浏览器解析 HTML

cues.en: into DOM nodes.
cues.zh: 变成 DOM 节点。

cues.en: Then your display logic just manipulates DOM nodes. So, they're doing basically the same thing. They're both rendering the UI
cues.zh: 然后显示逻辑只是操作 DOM 节点。所以它们基本上在做同一件事，都是在把 UI 渲染成

cues.en: to DOM data structures.
cues.zh: DOM 数据结构。

cues.en: So, what we're actually doing when we're using templates and display logic and separating those out, we're separating technologies,
cues.zh: 所以，当我们使用模板和显示逻辑并把它们分开时，实际上是在分离技术，

cues.en: not concerns.
cues.zh: 而不是关注点。

cues.en: And the problem with this is that the technologies
cues.zh: 问题在于，这些技术

cues.en: that we're we're separating are deliberately underpowered.
cues.zh: 我们分离出来的技术是被刻意弱化的。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: I'm gonna pick on handlebars for a second,
cues.zh: 我拿 Handlebars 举个例子，

cues.en: which is an extremely popular
cues.zh: 它是个极其流行的

cues.en: open source JavaScript templating solution.
cues.zh: 开源 JavaScript 模板方案。

cues.en: And it's a great one. It's really fast. It solves a lot of people's use cases.
cues.zh: 而且它很优秀，速度很快，解决了很多人用例的问题。

cues.en: But it falls into the the common trap of templates,
cues.zh: 但它掉进了模板的常见陷阱，

cues.en: which is you rely on primitive abstractions.
cues.zh: 也就是依赖原始抽象。

cues.en: So, example, if you want to reuse a template,
cues.zh: 比如，如果你想复用模板，

cues.en: the kind of standard way to do it in handlebars is to use something called a partial.
cues.zh: 在 Handlebars 里比较标准的做法是用所谓的 partial。

cues.en: And a partial is a is a mini template that you can include in other templates.
cues.zh: partial 就是一个迷你模板，可以包含在其他模板里。

cues.en: So, think of if you wanted a profile pic component on a social network and you reuse it all over the place. You would use a partial to implement that.
cues.zh: 想想社交网络里的头像组件，你在各处复用它，就会用 partial 来实现。

cues.en: Now, the problem is you're basically copying and pasting in this partial into a template and it gets all of the variables that the parent has in the in the current scope.
cues.zh: 问题在于，你基本上是把 partial 复制粘贴进模板，它会拿到父级当前作用域里的所有变量。

cues.en: This is a whole bunch of implicit dependencies now. So, because the the child template or the partial may be reading from any one of these variables,
cues.zh: 这就产生了一大堆隐式依赖。因为子模板或 partial 可能读取其中任何一个变量，

cues.en: you have to go track down every single call site that the partial is being used in order to make sure
cues.zh: 你就得追查 partial 被用到的每一个调用点，以确保

cues.en: that it's, you know, being updated correctly when you want to make a change to the partial.
cues.zh: 当你想修改 partial 时，它会被正确更新。

cues.en: And another symptom is relying on kind of flow control abstractions like each. So,
cues.zh: 另一个症状是依赖像 each 这样的流程控制抽象。所以，

cues.en: each basically iterates through each item of a sequence and emits some markup in a traditional templating language.
cues.zh: each 基本上会遍历序列中的每一项，并在传统模板语言里输出一些标记。

cues.en: What if you want to kind of change the way that you iterate over the list? Or what if you want to insert two pieces of markup
cues.zh: 如果你想改变遍历列表的方式呢？或者如果你想插入两段标记

cues.en: where the templating language only thought you would want to do one per list item?
cues.zh: 而模板语言却以为每个列表项你只想放一段？

cues.en: It's it's just difficult to deal with because you don't have the power of a full programming language. You have a... The power of a template language,
cues.zh: 这真的很难处理，因为你没有完整编程语言的能力。你只有……模板语言的能力，

cues.en: which is deliberately underpowered.
cues.zh: 而它被刻意做得很弱。

cues.en: So, are some other symptoms of this. I talked about
cues.zh: 所以，还有其他一些症状。我谈到过

cues.en: marking up an HTML document with directives
cues.zh: 用指令标记 HTML 文档

cues.en: to bring it to life.
cues.zh: 让它活起来。

cues.en: Now, in order to do that, you're basically trying to create a new way to express program semantics
cues.zh: 现在，要做到这一点，你基本上是在创造一种表达程序语义的新方式

cues.en: in a document. So, you're kind of like creating a new programming language.
cues.zh: 在文档里。所以，你有点像在创造一门新的编程语言。

cues.en: Now, the problem with this is that the way that that people are building these abstractions on the web today,
cues.zh: 问题是，如今人们在 Web 上构建这些抽象的方式，

cues.en: they don't accept that they're building a new programming language.
cues.zh: 他们不承认自己在构建一门新的编程语言。

cues.en: So, you have to invent a lot of new concepts that are slightly incompatible with, you know, a real programming language that we have today, JavaScript.
cues.zh: 所以，你得发明很多新概念，而这些概念和我们今天真正拥有的编程语言 JavaScript 有点不兼容。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: Angular is hugely popular these days. So, I obviously have to pick on them. And I've I've pulled this out of the Angular directive stocks, which is the way that you mark up a... An HTML document
cues.zh: Angular 现在非常流行。所以我显然得挑它开刀。我从 Angular 指令文档里翻出这个，也就是你标记 HTML 文档的方式

cues.en: and, you know, connect it with the JavaScript part of Angular.
cues.zh: 并且，你知道，把它和 Angular 的 JavaScript 部分连接起来。

cues.en: And I've highlighted all of the new concepts that they had to create that are already in JavaScript and that you have to learn.
cues.zh: 我标出了他们不得不创造的所有新概念，而这些概念 JavaScript 里早已有，你却还得学。

cues.en: So,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: there's a lot there.
cues.zh: 这里面有很多东西。

cues.en: And the point of all this is that a lot of the ways that we build applications today,
cues.zh: 这一切的重点是，今天我们构建应用的很多方式，

cues.en: the the frameworks and libraries we use,
cues.zh: 我们使用的框架和库，

cues.en: try to tell you how to separate your concerns for you.
cues.zh: 试图替你规定如何分离关注点。

cues.en: But we don't think that the framework can do that. Like your application... You don't think of your application in terms of models using controllers. You think of your application in terms of user profiles and navigation bars
cues.zh: 但我们不认为框架能做到这一点。比如你的应用……你不会用模型和控制器来思考你的应用。你会用用户资料和导航栏来思考应用

cues.en: and,
cues.zh: 以及，

cues.en: you know, posts on a timeline or something like that.
cues.zh: 你知道，时间线上的帖子之类的。

cues.en: So, we think that the framework of the library you're using
cues.zh: 所以，我们认为你使用的框架或库

cues.en: should just give you tools for you to express your program
cues.zh: 应该只给你工具，让你表达你的程序

cues.en: in the language of your problem domain
cues.zh: 用你问题领域的语言

cues.en: rather than the language of the framework itself.
cues.zh: 而不是框架本身的语言。

cues.en: So the tool that we came up with was a React component
cues.zh: 所以我们想出的工具是 React 组件

cues.en: and it's a highly cohesive building block
cues.zh: 它是一个高度内聚的构建块

cues.en: for building UIs that is loosely coupled with other components.
cues.zh: 用于构建 UI，并与其他组件松耦合。

cues.en: And so with React, even though we're combining the DOM generation
cues.zh: 所以用 React，即使我们把 DOM 生成

cues.en: part of your UI and the display logic that drives it, we can actually separate our concerns in a way that matches your application better
cues.zh: 部分和驱动它的显示逻辑组合在一起，我们实际上能以一种更贴合你的应用的方式分离关注点

cues.en: by using components with the full power of JavaScript rather than relying on a crippled templating language to do it for you.
cues.zh: 靠使用具备 JavaScript 全部能力的组件，而不是依赖一个残缺的模板语言替你完成。

cues.en: So, here's a very, very quick

cues.zh: 我还有一个实验性分支，能把整个应用跑在 Web Worker 里。再次强调，

cues.zh: 虚拟 DOM 和虚拟事件系统意味着我们可以替换掉这些底层细节，让它在外部环境中运行。这个分支大概只有 100 行代码，

cues.zh: 我们要做的基本上就是把 UI 线程的浏览器事件序列化传给 Web Worker，再把 DOM 操作从……

cues.zh: 或者说 DOM 操作的描述，从 Web Worker 传回 UI 线程，然后在 UI 线程中更新。

cues.en: Hi. Hey. How does this compare to web components?
cues.zh: 嗨，请问这跟 Web Components 相比有什么区别？

cues.en: That's a great question.
cues.zh: 问得很好。

cues.en: So
cues.zh: 关于这个，

cues.en: Web Components is a a big constantly changing,
cues.zh: Web Components 是一个庞大且不断演进的

cues.en: specification.
cues.zh: 规范。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: it's...
There's a lot there's a lot to say about it.
cues.zh: 这里面有很多值得探讨的地方。

cues.en: One of the things that we focus on a lot is composability.
cues.zh: 我们重点关注的核心之一是“可组合性”。

cues.en: So really, really deep
cues.zh: 也就是非常深入地

cues.en: building components out of other components.
cues.zh: 用组件去组合构建新的组件。

cues.en: And I don't think that historically web components has been focusing on that aspect.
cues.zh: 我觉得从历史发展来看，Web Components 并没有聚焦在这一层面上。

cues.en: And there's a lot of nuance there, so data flow between
cues.zh: 这其中有许多细微的讲究，比如

cues.en: a parent component and a child component.
cues.zh: 父组件与子组件之间的数据流传递。

cues.en: Additionally,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: Web Components is a bunch of different technologies.
cues.zh: Web Components 是一组不同技术的集合。

cues.en: So Shadow DOM is one big part of Web Components. And that's a that's a really interesting important part of of kind of pushing the web forward and that's something that we could take advantage of.
cues.zh: 其中 Shadow DOM 是很大的一块。它在推动 Web 发展方面非常有趣且重要，也是我们可以加以利用的技术。

cues.en: One kind of philosophical
cues.zh: 从设计哲学上来说，

cues.en: difference between Web Components and React is kind of how we perceive the DOM.
cues.zh: Web Components 和 React 的一个区别在于我们如何看待 DOM。

cues.en: So Web Components fully embraces the DOM and adds new APIs.
cues.zh: Web Components 全面拥抱 DOM 并为其扩展了新 API。

cues.en: React kind of hates the DOM and puts it away in its own little corner and we only interact with it through message passing basically.
cues.zh: 而 React 则有点“排斥”DOM，把它隔离在角落里，基本上只通过消息传递来与它交互。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 并且，

cues.en: one kind of advantage of that is that we can do things like render on the server and get a faster initial page load experience. I don't think that Web Components has solved the problem of rendering on the server
cues.zh: 这样设计的一个优势在于，我们可以做服务端渲染，从而获得更快的首屏加载体验。我认为 Web Components 还没能解决服务端渲染的问题，

cues.en: and basically doing a non blocking like page experience.
cues.zh: 以及如何实现这种非阻塞式的页面体验。

cues.zh: 有办法在

cues.en: between
cues.zh: 两次渲染

cues.en: renders?
cues.zh: 之间做过渡效果吗？

cues.en: So like CSS animations? Yeah, any kind of transition.
cues.zh: 比如 CSS 动画？对，任何形式的过渡。

cues.en: So we have a component called React transition group actually
cues.zh: 其实我们有一个叫 React Transition Group 的组件，

cues.en: that will look at how its children are changing. So if you add a list item for example,
cues.zh: 它会监听子元素的变化。比如你添加了一个列表项，

cues.en: you can implement a custom transition behavior. So the default one that we have behaves a lot like an animation library for Angular called ng animate. So it will add CSS classes for you. So it makes it kind of trivial to add
cues.zh: 你就可以实现自定义的过渡行为。我们默认提供的行为非常像 Angular 的一个叫 ng-animate 的动画库。它会自动为你添加 CSS 类，所以添加诸如

cues.en: kind of fade in behaviors and that kind of thing.
cues.zh: 淡入之类的效果就变得非常简单。

cues.en: You can override that behavior and and have custom transitions between DOM states if you'd like though.
cues.zh: 不过如果你愿意，也可以覆盖该行为，在 DOM 状态之间实现自定义过渡。

cues.en: And then a React thing re renders. How does it figure out... Or does it figure out
cues.zh: 然后 React 组件重新渲染了。它是怎么判断……或者它能判断出

cues.en: that it should leave that class there? Or does it say, oh, the diff is that class was removed? This is a great question. So
cues.zh: 应该保留那个 class 吗？还是说 diff 的结果是把那个 class 删掉了？这是个好问题。

cues.en: React kind of from day one had to interoperate with with legacy code.
cues.zh: React 基本上从第一天起就必须与遗留代码互操作。

cues.en: So we have a a set of life cycle hooks that basically, you know, they look a little bit like the Objective C Cocoa API. So we have component did mount and component will unmount,
cues.zh: 所以我们有一套生命周期钩子，其实它们看起来有点像 Objective-C Cocoa API。我们有 componentDidMount 和 componentWillUnmount，

cues.en: which basically tells...
cues.zh: 它们基本上表示……

cues.en: They fire when the component is initialized on the page and there's a DOM note available, and they fire when it's about to be destroyed.
cues.zh: 它们会在组件在页面上初始化、DOM 节点可用时触发，也会在组件即将被销毁时触发。

cues.en: So what you can do is in... You render a div, for example, as a React component. And then in componentDidMount,
cues.zh: 所以你可以这样做：比如你渲染一个 div 作为 React 组件，然后在 componentDidMount 中，

cues.en: you boot up your jQuery plug in. And then we have another hook that says componentDidUpdate,
cues.zh: 启动你的 jQuery 插件。接着我们还有另一个钩子叫 componentDidUpdate，

cues.en: which means there's new data available. So then you can bridge from the React...
cues.zh: 它表示有新数据了。然后你就可以把 React……

cues.en: The new data that React has gotten and tell jQuery, hey, the data has changed. And then in component will unmount, you just destroy your your your jQuery plugin.
cues.zh: 把 React 拿到的新数据告诉 jQuery：嘿，数据变了。然后在 componentWillUnmount 里，你直接销毁你的 jQuery 插件就行了。
